about: The prompt-injection patterns injection.py scans a recipe.md for. The patterns are data so they can be diffed, hashed and tested; SUITE_SHA256 pins this file and injection.py refuses to run when the two disagree. Every regex runs case-insensitive and multiline. A recipe instructs Blu inside an installer's project, so text aimed at the agent, the engine or the reviewer has no legitimate place in it.

scopes.all: every frontmatter text value and the body
scopes.body: the markdown body under the frontmatter
scopes.descriptions: the top-level description and every step description

patterns.label: override of earlier instructions
patterns.message: A recipe describes its own steps. It never tells the reader to set aside instructions it cannot see. Remove the sentence.

patterns.label: gives the agent a new identity
patterns.message: A step says what to build, not who Blu is. Remove the sentence that assigns a role.

patterns.label: system-prompt or chat-template marker
patterns.message: This looks like a chat-template or system-prompt marker. A recipe is plain instructions; remove it.

patterns.label: text aimed at the reviewer or a scanner
patterns.message: A recipe addresses the person installing it. It has no reason to address a reviewer or a scanner; remove the text.

patterns.label: tells the engine to run without the installer's approval
patterns.message: Blu shows the plan and waits for one approval before anything runs. A recipe cannot opt out of that; remove the sentence.

patterns.label: hides what runs from the installer
patterns.message: Everything a recipe does is shown to the installer. Remove the instruction to keep something from them.

patterns.label: asks for a credential
patterns.message: A recipe runs on the installer's own connected accounts. It never asks anyone for a key or password; remove the request.

patterns.label: invisible or direction-changing character
patterns.message: The text carries a character a reader cannot see. Retype the line without it.

patterns.label: encoded blob
patterns.message: A long encoded string cannot be read by the installer or the reviewer. Write the content out in plain words.

patterns.label: HTML comment in the body
allow: <!-- generated from the frontmatter by scripts/rebuild_bodies.py; edit the frontmatter -->
patterns.message: An HTML comment does not render, so nobody reading the recipe sees it. The body is generated from the frontmatter; remove the comment and regenerate the body.

patterns.label: HTML comment carrying an instruction
patterns.message: An HTML comment inside a step carries an instruction. Write the instruction in the step itself, or remove it.

patterns.label: link to a host outside intempt.com
patterns.message: A step description links outside intempt.com. Blu does not fetch instructions from the web; describe the content in the step, or make the link an inputs row the installer supplies.
